overall_goal: Clean up the kitchen by recycling packaging, setting the table, and loading dirty dishes into the dishwasher.

goals.rationale: The person opens the recycling bin, throws the cardboard box inside, and closes the lid.

goals.description: Clear the table and set it with tea towels.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves tea towels from a cupboard, moves an e-book reader and glasses out of the way, and lays the towels on the table.

goals.description: Wash and load a knife and chopping board into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person opens the dishwasher, removes a rice cooker bowl to make space, then scrubs a knife and chopping board before placing them in the racks.

goals.description: Wash and load spoons and a peeler into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves spoons and a peeler, rinses and scrubs them, and places them into the dishwasher cutlery tray.

goals.description: Wash and load a potato masher and the inner part of a plastic colander into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person scrubs the potato masher and the detached inner part of a plastic colander, then places both items on the top rack of the dishwasher.

goals.description: Wash and load the outer part of a plastic colander and a small bowl into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person scrubs the outer part of the plastic colander and a small bowl, rearranges items on the top rack, and places the newly washed items inside.

goals.description: Wash and load a saucepan and a metal colander into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person scrubs a saucepan, places it in the bottom rack, and then adds a metal colander on top before closing the dishwasher.

goals.description: Rinse and dry hands after loading the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person puts away the dishwasher brush, rinses their hands and a sponge under the tap, and dries their hands with a cloth.

goals.description: Load an additional knife into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person picks up another knife, opens the dishwasher, places it in the cutlery tray, and closes the door.

goals.description: Wash the rice cooker bowl with a sponge and washing up liquid.
goals.rationale: The person applies washing up liquid to a sponge and uses it to scrub the rice cooker bowl.
